patterns: Most-asked one-liners: architect/three-tier = Balwant Rai Mehta; two-tier = Ashok Mehta; first state = Rajasthan (Nagaur, 2 Oct 1959); constitutional status first suggested = L.M. Singhvi (APPSC key).
APPSC adds AP angles: AP first to implement PR across the whole state (1 Nov 1959), Mandal system under NTR, CDP aim = village development through public participation.
APPSC also asks committee chronology (BRM, Dantwala, Singhvi, Gadgil) and Ashok Mehta 'two tier, four-year term'; Nyaya Panchayat is not a tier.
Other PSCs test Panchayat Samiti = block-level administrative body, Nyaya Panchayats = Ashok Mehta, PR not a committee: Dinesh Goswami/V.K.R.V. Rao.
App MCQs go deeper than PYQs (1960s specialist committees, Collector-role comparisons, AP Acts) mostly via multi-statement/match formats.
